description: Inspect or synchronize a Git knowledge base with origin. Needs a Git working-tree root, origin, attached branch, and .gitignore rules .*.tmp and .tmp.* (temporary files of writes). Sync commits all changes with hostname and UTC time, pulls --no-rebase -X ours (this machine wins same-hunk edits), then pushes. Delete/modify conflicts abort with SyncConflict; missing or ineffective ignore rules print the two required .gitignore lines on stdout, then return IgnoreMissing without changing files. The final error line is memory_sync: error: CODE reason on both stdout and stderr (exit 1). Configure the root just like memory. Status uses cached origin refs; absent refs produce null ahead/behind.

op.description: status counts changed files and ahead/behind commits; sync commits, pulls and pushes.

timeout_s.description: Per Git command timeout in seconds, positive and at most 600.
